meta.title: Rule guard
meta.description: Adds a pure-local rule guard for agent shell commands: an ordinary call passes, and a command matching a dangerous pattern asks you through the default approval panel, with no timeout. Off by default it applies only where the effective permission is full sandbox plus ask — the guarded-full preset — so an existing preset behaves exactly as before; switch it on globally to guard every session. Configure guarded tools, dialect, built-in rules, patterns and the audit log on this row in Plugins.
